fields.Name: Schedule Next Agent Wake
fields.Description: Schedules or updates an autonomous agent wake routine in MJ: User Routines (RoutineType = 'AgentWake') with a 3-Tier Wake Gate (Tier 0 Entity Watermarks, Tier 1 SafeExpressionEvaluator, Tier 2 Decision Model, Tier 3 Prompt).

fields.Name: AgentID
fields.Description: Optional UUID of the AI Agent — leave blank when scheduling Chief of Staff (defaults automatically to 'Chief of Staff')

fields.Name: AgentName
fields.Description: Name of the AI Agent to wake (defaults to 'Chief of Staff' if omitted)

fields.Name: ScheduleMode
fields.Description: Schedule mode: 'OneShot', 'Adaptive', or 'Recurring'

fields.Name: NextWakeAt
fields.Description: ISO-8601 time of a OneShot or Adaptive wake. Same as WakeAtISO.

fields.Name: DelayMinutes
fields.Description: Minutes from now for a OneShot or Adaptive wake when no time is given. Same as WakeInMinutes.

fields.Name: CronExpression
fields.Description: Cron expression when ScheduleMode is 'Recurring' or 'Adaptive'

fields.Name: WakeReason
fields.Description: Concise explanation of why the agent is waking and what workstream it is checking

fields.Name: StateSummary
fields.Description: Summary of current workstream state to carry forward into the next wake run

fields.Name: ConversationID
fields.Description: Optional Conversation ID to post wake results to

fields.Name: WakeConfigurationJSON
fields.Description: 3-tier wake gate configuration (IRoutineWakeConfiguration JSON object or string)

fields.Name: RoutineID
fields.Description: ID of the created or updated UserRoutine record

fields.Name: ScheduledWakeTime
fields.Description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the scheduled next wake

fields.Name: WorkstreamKey
fields.Description: Names the workstream this wake belongs to (for example 'daily-briefing' or 'reminder-call-mom'). One routine per agent, user and key: scheduling the same key again updates that routine. Default 'default'.

fields.Name: Timezone
fields.Description: IANA time zone the CronExpression runs in (for example 'America/Chicago'). Pass the user's time zone for a Recurring wake so '0 9 * * 1-5' means 9:00 AM where the user is. Default 'UTC'.

fields.Name: WakeAtISO
fields.Description: ISO-8601 time of a OneShot or Adaptive wake. Same as NextWakeAt.

fields.Name: WakeInMinutes
fields.Description: Minutes from now for a OneShot or Adaptive wake when no time is given. Same as DelayMinutes.

fields.Name: WatchedEntities
fields.Description: JSON array of entities the wake gate watches for changes, for example [{ "entityName": "MJ: AI Agent Requests", "filter": "Status = 'Requested'", "trackChangesOnly": true }].

fields.Name: WakeGate
fields.Description: JSON object with the wake gate: tier1Expression (a deterministic expression), tier2DecisionQuestion (a yes/no question for the decision model) and skipIfUnchanged.

fields.Name: Configure Agent User Policy
fields.Description: Creates or updates the invoking user's MJ: AI Agent User Policies record (onboarding status, custom agent name, coordination mode, channel modes, approval switches, entity RLS/FLS narrowing rules, and action time-window policies).

fields.Name: AgentID
fields.Description: Optional UUID of the AI Agent — leave blank when configuring Chief of Staff (defaults automatically to 'Chief of Staff')

fields.Name: AgentName
fields.Description: Name of the AI Agent (defaults to 'Chief of Staff')

fields.Name: DisplayNameOverride
fields.Description: Optional custom nickname for the agent itself (e.g., 'Pepper' or 'Jarvis') — NOT the human user's name. Leave blank to keep 'Chief of Staff'.

fields.Name: OnboardingStatus
fields.Description: Onboarding status: 'NotStarted', 'InProgress', or 'Completed'

fields.Name: CoordinationMode
fields.Description: Coordination mode: 'Observer', 'Coordinator', or 'Autonomous'

fields.Name: EmailChannelMode
fields.Description: Email channel mode: 'Disabled', 'ReadOnly', 'DraftOnly', 'SendAsAgent', or 'SendAsUser'

fields.Name: CalendarChannelMode
fields.Description: Calendar channel mode: 'Disabled', 'ReadOnly', 'ProposeWithApproval', or 'Autonomous'

fields.Name: PhoneChannelMode
fields.Description: Phone channel mode: 'Disabled', 'InboundOnly', 'OutboundWithApproval', or 'OutboundAutonomous'

fields.Name: MessagingChannelMode
fields.Description: Messaging channel mode: 'Disabled' or 'Enabled'

fields.Name: InstructionsOverride
fields.Description: Custom standing instructions and preferences for this user

fields.Name: PolicyID
fields.Description: ID of the created or updated AIAgentUserPolicy record

fields.Name: Send Inter-Agent Request
fields.Description: Sends a structured coordination request from one user's Chief of Staff to another user's Chief of Staff while respecting sender CoordinationMode and recipient data boundaries.

fields.Name: TargetUserID
fields.Description: UUID of the target MJ User whose Chief of Staff should receive the request

fields.Name: TargetPersonID
fields.Description: UUID of the target Person record (resolved via People.LinkedUserID when TargetUserID is omitted)

fields.Name: Subject
fields.Description: Subject of the inter-agent coordination request

fields.Name: RequestBody
fields.Description: Structured message body for the recipient's Chief of Staff

fields.Name: RelatedEntityName
fields.Description: Optional related entity name (e.g., 'MJ: AI Agent Requests' or 'MJ: User Routines')

fields.Name: RelatedRecordID
fields.Description: Optional related record primary key

fields.Name: TargetConversationID
fields.Description: ID of the recipient's Chief of Staff conversation

fields.Name: RecipientName

fields.Name: RecipientPhone

fields.Name: UserApproved
fields.Description: Whether the user has explicitly approved this call (required when PhoneChannelMode is OutboundWithApproval)

Hard-pinned to ContextUser.Email and gated by EnterpriseMailboxSecurityGate.

fields.Name: EndDateTime

fields.Name: AttendeeEmails

fields.Name: DurationMinutes

fields.Name: Operation
fields.Description: Operation: 'ListMessages', 'SearchMessages', 'GetSingleMessage', 'CreateDraft', 'Send' (a new outbound email), 'Reply', or 'Forward'.
